newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices mixed on good general demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices mixed on good general demand.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at the weekly tea auction as good general demand continued, auction officials said on Monday.

Brighter BPls were a strong feature, rising by up to four U.S. cents, while better leaf coloury mediums gained 2-4 cents. Brighter PFls were firm to three cents dearer, while lighter grades were steady. Poorer leaf sorts of mediums and plainer lost value, while selected brightest DUST1s appreciated up to four cents. BMFs were firm to dearer.
Pakistan, Egypt and Sudan were the main buyers. The UK and Somalia were also in the market.
